Thanks for the loop, Vanessa — happy to take lead on comms edit. Quick notes after a first pass of the draft:

- The proposed quote is strong but a touch long for a homepage card. Suggest shortening to ~18–20 words. Candidate edit: "Redwood cut our inference latency by 3x and reduced token costs — enabling faster clinical decisions."
- For the logo: per Novus brand guide they require a minimum clear space equal to the height of their logotype and prohibit color inversion on dark backgrounds. The mockup you sent shows a small logo on a dark hero; we should switch to the white-background variant or use the outline with permission.
- Please confirm we include the trademark line beneath the logo: "Novus Health® is a registered trademark of Novus Health, Inc." If legal prefers, we can add a simple attribution line under the quote instead.

If legal signs off on usage scope (web, PDFs, conference slides), I'll finalize the copy and layout and ping design for final export.

—Marissa Cole
Director, Communications, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com

Attachment(s): (none)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.inference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novushealth.io>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Quick: can we approve logo + short quote for your site?

Vanessa / Marissa — legal is OK with the proposed usage with the following limited exceptions and requests:

1) License: We can publish the one-line quote and Novus logo on our website, marketing PDFs, and event materials for an initial 24-month period. After 24 months, Redwood must either remove assets or request renewal.
2) Attribution: Please include the trademark notice beneath the logo or in the caption — "Novus Health® is a registered trademark of Novus Health, Inc."
3) No endorsement language: We cannot state that Novus endorses Redwood's product beyond the factual quote. The edit Marissa proposed is acceptable.
4) Usage of Novus customer data or patient information is strictly prohibited — ensure the published case blurb contains no PHI.

I've attached a short release checklist and a one-paragraph release stub we'd like Novus to sign (simple JotForm/DocuSign will suffice). Once Novus signs the release, we are clear to publish.

—Priya Natarajan
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.inference.com

Attachment(s): release-stub.pdf (PDF)

Final copy (for publication):
"Redwood cut our inference latency by 3x and reduced token costs, enabling faster clinical decisions."

Logo treatment: Please provide the white-background horizontal logo (PNG, min width 160px). We'll place the trademark line beneath the logo: "Novus Health® is a registered trademark of Novus Health, Inc."

Usage scope: web, marketing PDFs, and conference/event decks for an initial 24 months (auto-expiry unless renewed). No PHI or patient-identifiable content may be included.

Next steps for Novus:
- Review and sign the short release here: https://go.docusign.com/novus-release/ND-2334 (or reply with your legal-approved version)
- Provide white-background logo PNG (min width 160px) to design@novushealth.io or attach here.

If that's all good, I'll schedule design to produce the site card and share a final preview before publish. Thanks everyone — cc'ing Marissa and Priya for visibility.

Best,
